# SYNTHETIC Aerospace-IVV-shaped parity fixture (A2.8b) — FAST SMOKE TIER

**THIS IS NOT REAL AEROSPACE / CSieve DATA.** It is a small, deterministic,
analytically-answered stand-in generated by
`scripts/generate-aerospace-synthetic-fixture.mjs`. Since A2.8c it is the
**fast smoke tier**: it validates the screening machinery end-to-end against an
exact closed-form key (where the ≤10 cm miss bound is meetable because the motion
is exactly representable). **Real CSieve parity now runs in CI unconditionally**
via the checked-in real window `tests/fixtures/aerospace-real-window/`
(`tests/aerospaceRealWindowParity.test.mjs`) — see that fixture's FINDING F1 for
the measured real-OCM parity. The `aerospaceScreenCatalogParity.test.mjs` gate
also still auto-switches THIS synthetic path to full REAL mode when the entire
21.74 GB `AerospaceIVVDataset_20251009a` is present locally
(`docs/aerospace-ivv-acquisition.md`, OWNER-ASSIST).

## What it is
- `ocm/<norad>.ocm` — 10 CCSDS-OCM-KVN ephemeris files, each a
  straight-line (constant-velocity) trajectory over
  [T0-300s, T0+300s], T0=2025-01-01T12:00:00.000Z, 10s step.
- `answer_key_spherical.csv` — CSieve-schema answer key computed in CLOSED FORM
  (each pair's miss vector is perpendicular to its relative velocity, so the
  closest approach is exactly at T0; miss=|missVec|, Vrel=|relVel|). This is an
  INDEPENDENT reference, not the module's own output.

## Coverage
- 90001-90002 [NLRV] miss=250.0m Vrel=11 km/s
- 90003-90004 [NLRV] miss=1500.0m Vrel=15 km/s
- 90005-90006 [LRV] miss=400.0m Vrel=0.03 km/s
- 90007-90008 [VLRV] miss=800.0m Vrel=0.005 km/s
- 90009-90010 [CONTROL] miss=15000m > 10km spherical threshold — must NOT be
  reported (event-set precision check).

## What it validates / does not
- VALIDATES: screen_catalog track ingestion, all-vs-all screening, TCA
  refinement, miss-distance geometry, event-set recall/precision, rel-vel
  stratification — end to end, in CI, with no network and no WasmEdge.
- Does NOT validate orbital dynamics or Pc numerics — that is the real dataset's
  role. Pc here is NULL (not gated; the User's Guide excludes Pc from CS
  validation regardless).
